name: Lisfranc Injury
definition: Injury of the tarsometatarsal joint complex ranging from ligament sprain to unstable fracture-dislocation; subtle injuries are frequently missed.

core: Stress of TMT complex when appropriate

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing imaging is important when safe.
investigations.MRI: CT defines fractures; MRI detects ligament injury when radiographs are equivocal.

green: Strict protection and urgent orthopedic review for suspected instability
amber: Unstable Lisfranc injuries generally require operative stabilization.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-sandhi/Snayu injury phenotype may be documented after modern stability assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Injury of the tarsometatarsal joint complex ranging from ligament sprain to unstable fracture-dislocation; subtle injuries are frequently missed.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.
